svg.aria-label: One-shot comparison: proposed single-round versus centralized
svg.text: Proposed (Single-Round) vs Centralized (One-Shot) • 100 robots / 100 tasks / capacity 1 • 100 paired seeds
Only complete trials have cost; Single-Round at PL10 has n=1
Success, sender bytes and modeled native stop time: all 100 seeds per loss point; unsuccessful native stops remain included.
Cost increase = 100 × (native full assignment cost / same-seed offline full-info Global Greedy cost − 1), complete trials only.
Cost missing after native failure is NOT zero. Sender Bytes include dropped SENDs. Rady + hypothetical 144 Mbps; native stop/commit guarantees differ.
